Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Politics Dzifa Tegah declares bid for NDC Deputy National Secretary position Source : Desmond Okraku Danso 26 October 2026 8:15pm Audio By Carbonatix
As the race for key leadership positions in the National Democratic Congress (NDC) gathers momentum, Dzifa Tegah has declared her intention to contest the position of Deputy National Secretary in the party’s upcoming national executive elections.
Speaking at the Campaign Trail, an initiative by the NDC Communications Bureau and Elections Directorate, Ms Tegah highlighted her years of grassroots engagement, which began during her university days and culminated in her rise to the position of Deputy Women’s Organiser.
She said her experience working with party members and touring constituencies across the country had equipped her with the knowledge and networks needed to serve in a more administrative capacity.
Ms Tegah explained that her ambition was to support the General Secretary in managing the party’s administrative affairs while helping to bring the national secretariat closer to the grassroots.
She expressed confidence that her leadership would help improve the party’s internal administration and strengthen engagement between the national leadership and members across the country.
Ms Tegah has appealed to delegates to support her bid when the NDC goes to the polls on December 19 to elect its next crop of national executives.
